
{{alias}}( x )
    Evaluates the error function for a single-precision floating-point number.

    The error function is defined as:

        erf(x) = (2/√π) ∫₀ˣ exp(-t²) dt

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: number
        Input value.

    Returns
    -------
    y: number
        Function value.

    Examples
    --------
    > var y = {{alias}}( 0.0 )
    0.0
    > y = {{alias}}( 1.0 )
    ~0.8427
    > y = {{alias}}( -1.0 )
    ~-0.8427
    > y = {{alias}}( 2.0 )
    ~0.9953
    > y = {{alias}}( NaN )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
